description: Entered Edison's organization after arriving in New York.
Left Edison Machine Works after a compensation dispute described by the museum account.
Tesla's employment within Edison's organization ended.
AC motor patent enabled Westinghouse commercialization.
The Westinghouse AC system gained a practical motor while Edison interests remained committed to DC.
Tesla-based AC architecture powered the fair.
General Electric's higher DC-oriented bid lost to Westinghouse's AC bid.
Tesla's AC architecture was demonstrated at infrastructure scale.
